title_en: Urgent Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Effectively Ensuring Judicial Personnel Perform Their Duties According to Law
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate

Urgent Notice on Effectively Ensuring Judicial Personnel's Performance of Duties in Accordance with the Law

Fa [2005] No. 173

High People's Courts and People's Procuratorates of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court and Military Procuratorate of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; the People's Procuratorate of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

In recent years, incidents of insulting, reviling, besieging, and beating adjudicators, procurators, and other personnel, thereby obstructing judicial personnel from performing their duties in accordance with the law, have occurred from time to time during court trial proceedings. To this end, the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission issued, on January 19, 2005, the "Opinions on Seriously Resolving the Problem of Obstructing and Retaliating Against Political and Legal Police Officers in the Performance of Their Duties According to Law" (Zhengfa [2005] No. 2). To effectively resolve the problem of obstructing judicial personnel from performing their duties in accordance with the law, protect the personal safety of judicial personnel, ensure the smooth progress of judicial work, and uphold the dignity of the law and judicial authority, the following notice is hereby given regarding the implementation of the relevant matters in the "Opinions on Seriously Resolving the Problem of Obstructing and Retaliating Against Political and Legal Police Officers in the Performance of Their Duties According to Law" of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission:

1. Attach High Importance to the Work of Ensuring that Judicial Personnel Perform Their Duties in Accordance with the Law

Holding court trials and appearing in court to support public prosecutions are important judicial activities in which adjudicators and procurators exercise the state's adjudicative power and procuratorial power in accordance with the law. Protecting the personal safety of adjudicators and procurators, ensuring the smooth progress of trial and prosecution work, and upholding the dignity of the law and judicial authority are necessary requirements and important guarantees for implementing the strategy of governing the country according to law and building a harmonious socialist society. People's courts and people's procuratorates at all levels must highly recognize the importance of ensuring that judicial personnel perform their duties in accordance with the law, actively take measures, provide necessary material guarantees for the smooth progress of trial and prosecution work, and create a good judicial environment. At the same time, people's courts and people's procuratorates at all levels must strictly regulate judicial conduct, achieve fair and civilized justice, continuously improve the judicial image, and win the understanding and support of the people through fair justice.

2. Vigorously Strengthen the Construction of People's Court Trial Tribunals and the Management of Security Work

People's courts at all levels, especially basic-level people's courts, must further strengthen the construction of trial tribunals and the management of security work, and effectively solve the necessary facilities and trial environment conditions for judicial personnel to perform their duties. First, strictly separate the trial activity area from the public gallery area, and respectively set up exclusive passages. Second, in accordance with the "Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on the Configuration of Specialized Equipment for People's Court Tribunals," promptly equip monitoring, security inspection, and other equipment, and deploy judicial police for security inspection. Third, set up warning signs in conspicuous positions in the trial venue to warn and educate participants in proceedings and members of the public gallery to comply with court rules. Fourth, the judicial police department must strictly comply with the "Rules of the People's Court Tribunal of the PRC," the "Rules of the People's Court Judicial Police on Duty in Court," and the "Rules of the People's Court Judicial Police on Security Inspection" and other relevant provisions. Before trial, strictly implement the deployment of judicial police forces for duty in court, and clarify the specific tasks and division of responsibilities of the judicial police on duty in court. The entire process of the court trial must be monitored; persons carrying weapons, instruments, flammable and explosive materials, strongly corrosive substances, or other dangerous items are strictly prohibited from entering the tribunal, so as to ensure the smooth progress of the trial activities and the personal safety of judicial personnel, and to protect the judicial personnel's safe departure from the trial venue after the trial.

Regarding the funds required for the above facility construction, people's courts at all levels must, in accordance with the relevant requirements of the "Opinions" of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, promptly report to the local Party committee and the Political and Legal Affairs Commission for proper resolution. The tribunal construction of basic-level courts may be systematically resolved within the three-year development plan.

3. Deploy Judicial Police, Ensure Official Vehicles, and Guarantee that Procurators Perform Their Duties in Accordance with the Law

When procurators of the people's procuratorate perform duties in court, there shall be no fewer than two persons. Where circumstances that may obstruct procurators from performing their duties in accordance with the law are anticipated, the judicial police of the people's procuratorate shall cooperate in deploying police forces, and carry and use police equipment in accordance with relevant regulations. The judicial police of the people's procuratorate shall strengthen coordination with the judicial police of the people's court, and when necessary, escort procurators to and from court, ensuring the procurators' performance of duties in accordance with the law and their personal safety. People's procuratorates at all levels shall ensure the official vehicles needed for procurators' appearances in court.

4. Formulate On-Site Contingency Plans for Court Proceedings, Organize and Implement Response and Preventive Measures

Before court trials, people's courts and people's procuratorates shall, based on the circumstances of the case, respectively formulate on-site contingency plans, fully anticipating possible obstructive conduct against judicial personnel. Where situations may arise that obstruct judicial personnel from performing their duties in accordance with the law, the people's court and the people's procuratorate shall jointly formulate contingency plans, study countermeasures, take measures, and notify the public security organs as the circumstances require. When necessary, reports may be made to the Party committee's Political and Legal Affairs Commission or higher-level authorities to jointly coordinate and carry out preventive work.

5. Handle Conduct Obstructing Judicial Personnel from Performing Their Duties in Accordance with the Law Seriously According to Law

During court trials, if participants in proceedings or members of the public gallery obstruct judicial personnel from performing their duties in accordance with the law, the people's court shall, in accordance with the "Criminal Procedure Law of the PRC," the "Civil Procedure Law of the PRC," the "Administrative Procedure Law of the PRC," the "Rules of the People's Court Tribunal of the PRC," and other relevant provisions, promptly take measures such as stopping the conduct, admonishing, forcibly removing from the court, imposing fines, or ordering detention; if state functionaries obstruct judicial personnel from performing their duties in accordance with the law, the relevant departments shall simultaneously be recommended to impose Party discipline and administrative sanctions; if the conduct seriously disturbs court order and constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be pursued according to law, and the handling shall be made public to serve as a warning to others. For typical incidents that seriously obstruct judicial personnel from performing their duties in accordance with the law and cause adverse social impact, the people's court and the people's procuratorate shall promptly report to the Party committee's Political and Legal Affairs Commission and higher-level authorities. While ensuring strict handling according to law to uphold the dignity of the law and judicial authority, attention shall also be paid to methods and approaches, timely resolution of conflicts, and prevention of the situation from escalating further.

6. Strengthen the Construction of Judicial Police Forces and Confidentiality Work, and Conduct Propaganda and Education Work

People's courts and people's procuratorates at all levels shall strengthen the construction of judicial police forces, organize specialized training, establish rapid response mechanisms, and enhance the ability of judicial police to handle emergency incidents; strengthen the confidentiality of case work, strictly prohibit leaking case details or personal information such as the communication methods and addresses of case-handling personnel in violation of regulations. Any acts of leakage shall be severely punished in accordance with the "Measures for Disciplinary Sanctions in People's Court Trial Work" and the "Regulations on Disciplinary Sanctions for Procuratorial Personnel"; strengthen education and training on safety awareness, self-protection awareness, and safety prevention skills for judicial staff, establish and improve measures for ensuring and providing relief to political and legal police officers performing their duties in accordance with the law; where conditions permit, purchase personal insurance for them; strengthen legal publicity and education work to enhance the public's legal awareness, and foster a good social atmosphere that respects the law and upholds justice.

August 25, 2005
